top_signals.title: Chile’s Long-Term Swaps Defy Stalled Economy to Hit 18-Month High
top_signals.summary: Chile’s long-dated swaps are at the highest level in 18 months as investors retain faith in the outlook for the economy, despite months of bad news, while the fiscal position remains weak and US Treasury yields soar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Zambia’s Bond Sale Draws Robust Demand After Hichilema Wins Vote
top_signals.summary: Zambia’s borrowing costs fell in the first bond auction since this month’s elections as investors bet that political continuity will bolster the prospects of Africa’s second-biggest copper producer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Hackers infecting Android car systems to build proxy botnet
top_signals.summary: A malware is being used to infect Android-based car systems, turning the devices into part of a botnet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
